### Quick Tips

1. **Call Ahead** – Even if a menu lists vegetarian dishes, it’s good to confirm that they can accommodate dietary restrictions (e.g., no fish sauce or shrimp paste).
2. **Ask About “Veggie” Options** – Many places will happily create a vegetarian version of a dish if you ask.
3. **Check Online Menus** – Most of the restaurants listed have online menus that clearly label vegetarian/vegan items.

Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure in Chicago!
